0.content: Showcase your brand to over 30,000+ buyers, distributors, and F&B professionals. This is your chance to shine in one of Southeast Asia's biggest food markets.

1.content: Your pass also gets you into the Franchise & License Expo (FLEI). Discover even more business models and opportunities, all in one place.

2.content: Your ticket includes full access to the Cafe & Brasserie Expo. Explore the latest in coffee, pastry, and cutting-edge cafe tech. A must-visit for cafe owners!

3.content: Indonesia is the world's largest Halal food consumption market! It's a multi-billion dollar opportunity waiting for the right products. Are you ready?

4.content: Wear your most comfortable shoes! With over 20,000m² of space and 1,200+ exhibitors to explore, you'll be doing a lot of walking (and even more tasting!).

5.content: Want to get the best price for your ticket? Follow us on social media to be the first to know when our Early Bird promo launches. Don't miss out!

mainPrograms.title: Main Programs
mainPrograms.description: Every corner of the expo is an opportunity to learn, connect, and get inspired. We've designed a full schedule of programs to help you get the most out of your visit.

0.title: The Global Marketplace
0.description: This is the heart of the event. Explore 20,000m² of space packed with over 1,200 exhibitors from around the world. Discover thousands of new products, ingredients, and technologies, all under one roof.

1.title: MoreFood Talks: Industry Summits
1.description: Gain a competitive edge with insights from top industry leaders, market analysts, and successful entrepreneurs. Our conference series covers the future of F&B, Halal market trends, and sustainable business practices.

2.title: Launch Pad: The Innovation Stage
2.description: Be the first to witness the unveiling of brand-new products. Our dedicated Launch Pad stage is where innovative brands debut their latest creations, from groundbreaking food tech to exciting new flavors.

3.title: The Inspiration Zone
3.description: A hands-on, interactive area designed to spark your creativity. Engage with sensory displays, discover unique food pairings, and get inspired by innovative cafe concepts and retail layouts.

4.title: Business Matching Service
4.description: Let us play cupid. We'll connect you with pre-vetted buyers for focused, productive meetings that get straight to the point.

5.title: Chef's Table: Live Cooking Demos
5.description: See, smell, and taste the future. Renowned chefs take to the stage to transform exhibitors' products into culinary masterpieces. Get front-row seats to live cooking, recipe ideas, and delicious free samples.

6.title: Creator's Hub: KOL Live Streams
6.description: Feel the buzz! Top food influencers and content creators will be broadcasting live from our Creator's Hub. Watch them discover trends, interview brand owners, and share the excitement with millions online.

7.title: Halal Market Workshops
7.description: Your practical guide to succeeding in the Halal market. Join our expert-led workshops covering everything from the Halal certification process in Indonesia to marketing strategies for reaching Muslim consumers. Limited seats available.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about our event, tickets, exhibitors, and more.
faq.emptyState: We are gathering commonly asked questions. Please come back later.
faq.contactTitle: Have any questions? Just send it to us!

0.q: When and where will {eventTitle} take place?
0.a: {eventTitle} will be held on {eventDate}, from {eventTime}, at {eventLocation}.

1.q: How do I get tickets to attend the event?
1.a: You can get your tickets through our official website. Simply click the Get Ticket button and follow the registration process. E-tickets will be sent to your email and WhatsApp after purchase.

2.q: How much does a ticket cost?
2.a: Ticket prices vary depending on the ticket type and promotional period. Please visit our Ticket page for the most up-to-date pricing information. Don't miss our early bird and pre-sale promotions for special discounts!

3.q: Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
3.a: All ticket sales are final. There are no refunds or exchanges once a ticket has been purchased. Please review our Ticket Refund and Return Policy for more details.

4.q: What should I bring to the event?
4.a: Please bring your e-ticket (digital or printed) to be exchanged for a badge or wristband at the registration counter. We also recommend bringing business cards if you plan to network with exhibitors and other attendees.

5.a: The event is open to everyone! Whether you're a cafe owner, F&B entrepreneur, coffee enthusiast, food industry professional, or simply someone who loves exploring culinary trends, you're welcome to attend!

6.q: What brands and products will be showcased at the event?
6.a: We feature a diverse range of F&B brands, equipment suppliers, ingredient providers, and service companies. From coffee machines and cafe furniture to food ingredients and packaging solutions. You can view the list of exhibitors on our Brands page.

7.q: How can I become an exhibitor?
7.a: To become an exhibitor and showcase your F&B products or services, please visit our Exhibitor Registration page or contact our team via WhatsApp for more information about booth packages and availability.

8.q: Will there be product sampling or tasting sessions?
8.a: Yes! Many exhibitors offer product sampling and tasting sessions at their booths. This is a great opportunity to discover new products, ingredients, and flavors for your business or personal enjoyment.

9.q: Are there any seminars or workshops at the event?
9.a: Yes! We organize various seminars, workshops, and demo sessions covering topics like brewing techniques, food trends, business strategies, and industry insights. Check our Rundown page for the complete schedule.

10.q: How can I become a sponsor or media partner?
10.a: We welcome sponsorship and media partnership opportunities. Please contact us via WhatsApp or {email} to discuss partnership packages.

11.q: Is there parking available at the venue?
11.a: Yes, the venue provides parking facilities. However, we recommend arriving early as parking spaces may fill up quickly during peak hours. You may also consider using public transportation or ride-sharing services.

12.q: Can I take photos or videos at the event?
12.a: Personal photography and video recording for non-commercial purposes are allowed. However, professional or commercial recording requires written permission from the organizer. Please refer to our Event Policy for more details.

13.q: How can I stay updated about the event?
13.a: Follow us on Instagram {'@'}{instagram} for the latest updates, announcements, and exclusive content. You can also check our News page for articles and updates.

14.q: How do I contact the organizer?
14.a:
You can reach us through:

  • WhatsApp: Click here to chat
  • Email: {email}

Visit our Help Center for more contact options and quick links to useful information.
